sql_calls.sql_query:
WITH requested_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-02-20'::date,
    ('2025-02-22'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN requested_dates rd ON rd.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 714
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_dates) AS nights_requested,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS nights_available
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Booked'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible)
    AND (SELECT nights_available FROM counts) = (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts)
  RETURNING ra.date, ra.price
)
SELECT
  (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts) AS nights_requested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS nights_booked,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM updated) AS total_price

sql_calls.sql_query:
WITH requested_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-02-15'::date,
    ('2025-02-17'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN requested_dates rd ON rd.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 717
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_dates) AS nights_requested,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS nights_available
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Booked'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible)
    AND (SELECT nights_available FROM counts) = (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts)
  RETURNING ra.date, ra.price
)
SELECT
  (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts) AS nights_requested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS nights_booked,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM updated) AS total_price

WITH requested_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-04-12'::date,
    ('2025-04-14'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  )::date AS date
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.price
  FROM room_availability ra
  JOIN requested_dates rd ON rd.date = ra.date
  WHERE ra.room_number = 217
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requested_dates) AS nights_requested,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS nights_available
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE room_availability ra
  SET status = 'Booked'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible)
    AND (SELECT nights_available FROM counts) = (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts)
  RETURNING ra.date, ra.price
)
SELECT
  (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts) AS nights_requested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS nights_booked,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM updated) AS total_price

WITH requested_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    '2025-03-18'::date,
    ('2025-03-20'::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,

  )::date AS date
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT ra.id, ra.price

  WHERE ra.room_number = 1915
    AND ra.status = 'Available'
    AND ra.price IS NOT NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
counts AS (

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS nights_available
),
updated AS (

  SET status = 'Booked'
  WHERE ra.id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible)

  RETURNING ra.date, ra.price
)
SELECT
  (SELECT nights_requested FROM counts) AS nights_requested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS nights_booked,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) FROM updated) AS total_price
